title: Public roadmap page
summary: Surface planned and in-flight work on the status site from repo-root JSON with no build step.

title: Roadmap status filters
summary: Let visitors narrow the roadmap list by Planned, In progress, Paused, and Shipped labels.

title: Roadmap JSON seed data
summary: Check in sample roadmap entries at the repo root so local preview and Pages can exercise every status.

title: CMS-backed roadmap editing
summary: Author roadmap items in a headless CMS instead of git commits; deferred until the static pilot stabilizes.

title: Roadmap RSS or Atom feed
summary: Publish status changes as a feed for subscribers once the on-page roadmap UI ships.

title: Roadmap entry deep links
summary: Stable fragment URLs for individual roadmap items to share in release notes and support tickets.

title: Third-party roadmap sync
summary: Mirror items from an external product board; paused while we validate the file-based workflow.

title: Changelog cross-links
summary: Link shipped roadmap items to matching changelog entries on the home page.
